title: useHash:true makes it render slower.
body:
If I use the _useHash_ option under _urlSync_, the results renderization gets really slow.

Here's **without** _useHash_:
![without useHash](http://g.recordit.co/A1n7bNNLN7.gif)
(video: http://recordit.co/A1n7bNNLN7)

And **with** _useHash_:
![with useHash](http://g.recordit.co/8bxwVUGy9B.gif)
(video: http://recordit.co/8bxwVUGy9B)
